name: sheen-slide-in
title: Sheen Slide In
description: A title glides in from the right with a long settle while a gradient sheen sweeps through the glyphs.
useWhen: An intro title should arrive with momentum: a fast entrance, a long exponential settle and a barely visible creep into center.
A colored gradient highlight sweeps once through the glyphs while the title settles.
avoidWhen: You want a repeating metallic shimmer loop: use shimmer-sweep.
The title should build word by word: use word-push or word-stream.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Exit at
variables.description: Frame where the title shrinks away (30 fps).

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Base color
variables.description: Text color once the sheen has passed.

variables.label: Sheen color
variables.description: Color of the gradient that sweeps through the letters.
